Slopculator · In development

Calculator with a paper tape

A calculator with a paper tape, units, currency, dates and times. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slopculator has these main features: Brackets, percentages, powers and roots; Units, currency and manual exchange rates.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slopculator

  • Date calculator: days between two dates
  • Time calculator: add and subtract hours and minutes
  • Percentage calculator
  • Unit converter with exact factors
